About Ayush
Construction

Company Overview

Ayush Construction has carved out a name of pride in the field of Civil Construction of major industries like Power Plants & Cement Plants. Presently the company is also doing infrastructure projects and plans to enter these fields in a big way.

Recently, the company has diversified into Real Estate and is constructing Townships, Residential & Commercial Complexes, Malls, and more. We are majorly involved in big projects having vast volume of concrete & reinforcement such as cement & thermal power plants.

Since 2002 we are into this business and are associated with esteemed clients like Ultratech, Star Cement, Bishakha etc. We carry out this business under three different names.
